chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: I have quoted a selected part of this sermon before, but since I have found in this narration that it differs from the previous one in terms of addition and omission, the circumstance necessitated establishing it again.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الشَّرِيفُ الرَّضِيّ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, the compiler of Nahj al-Balagha

ai.seo_question: Why did As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī include this specific version of the sermon in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi demonstrates his rigorous scholarly methodology by prioritizing textual fidelity over consistency, choosing to preserve a variant narration with distinct additions and omissions to ensure the completeness of Imam Ali's sermon. This editorial choice highlights the importance of *isnad* (chain of transmission) variations in Shia hadith sciences, reflecting the dynamic preservation of oral and written traditions during the compilation of Nahj al-Balagha.
